dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do you have any brothers or sisters?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈbrʌðərz ɔːr ˈsɪstərz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, a younger sister. And you?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ə ˈjʌŋɡər ˈsɪstər. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I have an older brother and a younger brother.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæv ən ˈoʊldər ˈbrʌðər ənd ə ˈjʌŋɡər ˈbrʌðər.
